name: Irma Perry
bio: Richard Le Gallienne's third wife, married on 27 October 1911, four months after his divorce from Julie Norregaard. Her own previous marriage - to her first cousin, the painter and sculptor Roland Hinton Perry - had been dissolved in 1904. She was with Le Gallienne in Paris from the late 1920s and no separation is recorded before his death at Menton in 1947.
bio_note: No dates recorded in the sources read. Her daughter Gwen took the name Gwen Le Gallienne and was, per the article, 'almost certainly not his natural daughter'. Wikidata carries nothing for this marriage.
